content:
Thrilled to share that I've officially joined the CDS Hooks Project Management Committee! 🎉

Having worked with the CDS Hooks standard since 2017, I'm incredibly passionate about its potential to improve clinical decision support and patient care. I'm excited to bring my experience to this role and contribute to moving the standard forward.

CDS Hooks has been instrumental in [mention a specific positive impact or benefit you've witnessed or experienced with the standard - e.g., improving medication adherence, reducing alert fatigue, etc.] and I believe it can have an even greater impact on healthcare.

If you're already leveraging CDS Hooks in your organization, please consider adding your implementation to the comprehensive list on the CDS Hooks Availability Wiki: [https://github.com/cds-hooks/docs/wiki/CDS-Hooks-Availability] Sharing your experience helps the community learn and grow!

And if you're not yet taking advantage of CDS Hooks, I'd be happy to help! As a freelance consultant, I offer support in all aspects of CDS Hooks implementation, from initial planning to ongoing maintenance. Feel free to reach out to discuss your needs and how I can assist you.

Let's work together to make clinical decision support more impactful and improve patient outcomes! #CDSHooks #ClinicalDecisionSupport #HealthcareIT #FHIR #Interoperability #HealthTech #Consulting #ProjectManagement
